deals.notes: The 2015-04-20 N-14 excerpts only show a governance comparison with an unnamed 'Target Fund' (members, manager); target, acquirer role and outcome are not stated in the excerpts. The registrant is described as non-traded. Separately, 2016 filings propose withdrawing BDC status, reorganizing the same company as a Delaware statutory trust and becoming an interval fund; shareholders approved these on 2016-12-28 (8-K filed 2017-01-05). That is a reorganization of one fund, not a merger of two listed funds.
